text:
acme-payments: Hey Redwood — we started getting 422 schema validation errors from our integration tests when the model is supposed to call the payments tool. It began after we updated our system prompt and added a couple of few-shot examples.

sam-support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the failing request + the exact response body you received?

acme-payments: Here's the curl and the response we see in prod (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \-H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' \-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \-d '{"model":"redwood-3b-instruct","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful and explain things"},{"role":"user","content":"Create payment for $50 to acct 999."}],"functions":[{"name":"payments.create","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"account":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","account"]}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-xyz",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "Payment created — ID: pay_12345. Confirmed to user. // processed successfully",
        "finish_reason": "stop"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

acme-payments: So instead of returning a function_call JSON object, the assistant returned a human-readable string. Our webhook expects the model to call the function. The SDK then validates and rejects the response -> 422.

sam-support: Thanks, that helps. Two quick checks: did you change the few-shot examples to include any human commentary after the JSON? And does the system prompt contain any lines like "be chatty" or "explain to the user"?

acme-payments: Yes — our examples had this pattern: Example 1: "Result: Payment created (see id)
{"amount":50,"account":"999"}" — i.e., human text immediately before the JSON. The system prompt also had "feel free to be conversational" text.

devon-ml: This is classic prompt-induced schema drift. Few-shot examples that include natural language before/after the JSON teach the model to emit plain text rather than triggering function_call. Also, system instructions that encourage "conversational" output will bias results away from strict function outputs.

maria-sre: We also see repeated occurrences in the logs where the assistant.content contains human prose and never the function_call field. That aligns with the 422s. Logs attached (snippet):

```text
Validator: expected object at root (payments.create.arguments)
Received: string starting with 'Payment created — ID:'
TraceID: rwd-logs-2026-10-12-5583
```

sam-support: Short-term workaround: force the function call by setting function_call to {"name":"payments.create"} in the request (instead of "auto"). That forces the model to use the function channel regardless of prompt noise. Also, removing the permissive system prompt helps.

devon-ml: Long term: 1) Remove human commentary from few-shot examples or move human commentary _after_ the JSON and separate with explicit delimiters. 2) End examples exactly at the JSON object (no trailing text). 3) Add a clear system instruction: "When invoking functions, output MUST be a function_call with JSON arguments only." 4) Add a strict JSON schema to the function definition (you already have it; ensure it is comprehensive). 5) Consider a model variant or instruction set tuned for JSON-only tool outputs.

sam-support: I'm going to try the forced function_call approach and also deploy a short-lived patch that rejects completions which are strings when function_call is expected (to fail fast and return a clear error to callers).

acme-payments: Quick test — we set function_call to the explicit name in our test harness and re-ran: it now returns a function_call with arguments exactly matching our schema. No 422s.

acme-payments: Trace: HTTP/1.1 200 OK -> assistant.message.function_call: {"name":"payments.create","arguments":"{\"amount\":50,\"account\":\"999\"}"} -> webhook accepted -> status OK.

sam-support: Great. Action items:
- acme-payments: remove human prose from few-shot examples and re-test (owner: acme-integration).
- devon-ml: add a short KB note on few-shot vs function_call interactions + example diff (owner: devon).
- eng-ops: add a console warning when a user-defined system prompt contains phrases like "be chatty" while functions are present (owner: maria-sre).

devon-ml: I'll draft the KB and a minimal example patch we can include in the console with suggested fix snippets. I'll include the 'force function_call' snippet as a recommended immediate mitigation.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: Docs PR created by devon-ml (#512) — staging build passed.

sam-support: marking this thread as triaged. Please follow up if the KB or console warning doesn't prevent future regressions. :thumbsup:

acme-payments: Thanks all — we'll confirm once examples are cleaned up.
